question: TCS Ninja/Prime (NQT) technical interview: **What is polymorphism? Explain compile-time versus runtime polymorphism and write code that demonstrates both, then explain from the code why one happens at compile time and the other at runtime.** (The interviewer started from OOP concepts in general.)
lookingFor: Can you define polymorphism precisely and give the right two categories?
Do you understand overloading versus overriding and when each is resolved?
Can you write correct code and trace it?
Do you know dynamic dispatch and virtual method calls conceptually?
Ability to explain, not just recite.
followUps: Can you overload a method by changing only the return type? Why not?
What are the rules for overriding (access, exceptions, covariant return)?
Is polymorphism possible with static methods? What is method hiding?
What is the difference between an abstract class and an interface?
